item.title: China Scoops Up Data That Could Aid Its Forces in Waters Around Taiwan
item.description: A flurry of Chinese ships were recently sent to map the seabed in research that Taiwan says aids “battlespace preparation.”

item.title: Chinese Executive Close to Nvidia CEO Suspected of Giving China Information
item.description: Investigators believed the woman, Alice Huang, was recruited based on her relationship with Jensen Huang.

item.title: As Missile Stockpiles Dwindle and China Looms, U.S. Turns to Japan for Production
item.description: Tokyo and Washington agreed to establish a facility in Japan to assemble key air-to-air missiles.

item.title: Kim Jong Un Makes Surprise Trip to China, Crosses New Bridge
item.description: Ties are warming between Beijing and Pyongyang, though Chinese leader Xi Jinping didn’t attend the get-together.

item.title: China’s Xi Demands More Loyalty as Purges Trim Party Elite
item.description: The Chinese leader is tightening his grip on the Communist Party with relentless purges and new strictures on discipline.

item.title: Global Soccer Star Kylian Mbappé Just Apologized to China—for a Mao Zedong Meme
item.description: The striker was dropped by Chinese sponsors after laughing at an image of his face on the former Chinese leader’s body and referring to him as a “dictator.”

item.title: China Claims Strong Economic Growth, but Skeptics Question Official Figures
item.description: Beijing has reported robust growth this year, but a growing chorus of economists are asking if the numbers are accurate.

item.title: Xi Wants to Play Peacemaker. Trump Has Other Ideas for a Historic Summit.
item.description: Plus, Xinjiang goes from blacklisted to global trade hub, Xi’s purges echo Stalin’s, and Kim Jong Un makes a surprise trip to China.

item.title: China’s Industrial Profit Growth Surged in September
item.description: China’s industrial profit growth rose 14.4% from a year earlier in September, supported by strong gains in electronics and high-tech manufacturing linked to AI and digital-infrastructure spending.

item.title: As China Encroaches, Even New Zealand Is Getting Serious About Its Military
item.description: Billions will be spent in the coming years—including on missiles, drones and base upgrades—as the remote country squares up to a widening threat.

item.title: The U.S. Navy’s New Insurance Policy for War With China Is an Australian Base
item.description: The Pentagon plans to deploy submarines to an expanding facility in allies’ strategy to deter Beijing.

item.title: Shifting U.S. Alliances Push Rivals China and India Together
item.description: As President Trump blows hot and cold, a summit in New Delhi presents an opportunity for two giant neighbors to smooth over their differences.
